author: Ahmadghulam
quote: The dungeons are where Ocarina of Time earns its reputation as a puzzle game. In the Forest Temple, a corridor twists and leaves a treasure chest sitting sideways on a wall. Just seeing it there made me reconsider the room I’d walked through. The Water Temple asks something different of me. I have to picture how changing the water level will affect a doorway I saw on another floor. There’s real satisfaction in standing on a balcony, looking across that enormous chamber, and finally understanding how the whole building fits together. Putting the Iron Boots on the D-pad is one of the remake’s smartest changes. I can test an idea while I still have the room pictured in my head
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Ahmadghulam
quote: 2/10. The biggest disappointment for me was how easy it was to put GTA VI down. I wanted that “one more mission” feeling, where it’s getting late and I keep playing because I need to know what happens next. Jason and Lucia’s story never gave me that pull.“Feng Shui” sums up my problem with the missions. Jason wants to get his place ready before Lucia comes home. That’s a nice detail about him. I got the point when he and Cal moved the TV. By the time the coffee table, couch, and chair each had their turn, I felt like I’d spent my evening helping a friend move.I also found the game overly sexualized, to the point that it distracted me from the characters. Vice City gives me the freedom to drive off and do whatever I want. After a while, though, I was just driving around because there wasn’t a mission I was excited to start. For a game I picked up for its story, that’s what earns it a 2/10 from me.
